items.html: Tom Sole, the son of Scotland rugby union international David Sole, made his ODI debut for Scotland in 2018, the season after he made a successful List A debut for Northamptonshire against the touring South Africans, scoring 54 off just 43 balls.

An offspinner, he also turned out for the Steelbacks in the T20 Blast in 2018 following a lengthy lay-off with an ankle injury.
